summary: OpenCode made DeepSeek V4.1 Flash free on 2026-10-15. OpenCode's Console docs list DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free (model id deepseek-v4.1-flash-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time, on the https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions endpoint. No end date is stated. Per OpenCode's docs, its provider follows a zero-retention policy and does not use your data for model training. The paid DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model (deepseek-v4.1-flash) is listed separately at $0.30/$1.20 per 1M input/output tokens, so pick the Free variant.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Console and copy your API key. The general Console setup also asks for billing details and credits.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free (opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free), not the paid DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
Or call https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions with model deepseek-v4.1-flash-free. The free period is limited-time.
Review Console billing before funding: auto-reload defaults to $20 when the balance goes below $5.
